IDK_DAMTRAIL.desc: Up into the high ranges to one of Asia's highest arch dams, with Hill View Park and the island views from Kalvari Mount.
IDK_DAMTRAIL.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Muvattupuzha 7:00 · Thodupuzha 7:30)
8:45 AM — Nadukani viewpoint: A hilltop pavilion on the climb, looking far down over Moolamattam and the plains. (Photo stop)
10:00 AM — Idukki & Cheruthoni dams: The arch dam between two granite hills; walk the dam top on visitor days. (Visitor days only · tickets online)
11:45 AM — Hill View Park: Gardens and a lookout over the reservoir. Lunch at Cheruthoni after. (Entry own expense)
2:30 PM — Kalvari Mount: A grassy ridge high above the Idukki reservoir and its forested islands — the district's best view. (Short uphill walk)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_DAMTRAIL.gtk:
🏞️ Visiting the dam: The dam top opens to the public only on announced dates, with tickets booked online. Cameras are not allowed in the restricted area. On other days we view both dams from Hill View Park and Idukki Park instead — same price.
🌧️ Weather: Mist and rain can hide the views; red-alert days close the dams and hill roads. Clearest from October to March. Carry a light layer.
⛰️ Hill roads: About 2 hours up from Thodupuzha on hairpin roads via Moolamattam and Kulamavu. Motion sickness? Sit in front and tell us — we stop at wide spots.
🚌 Pickup points: Muvattupuzha first, then Thodupuzha — exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
IDK_DAMTRAIL.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_DAMTRAIL.exc: Lunch; Dam, park and activity tickets; Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_DAMTRAIL.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for tickets

IDK_MALANKARA.desc: An easy waterfall day close to home: a forest walk past the stepped cascades of Thommankuthu, the broad curtain of Anayadikuthu and a quiet afternoon by the Malankara reservoir.
IDK_MALANKARA.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Muvattupuzha 8:00 · Thodupuzha 8:30)
9:15 AM — Thommankuthu Falls: A forest walk up the Kaliyar river past the first of its seven stepped cascades and rock pools. (Forest ticket, paid direct)
11:45 AM — Anayadikuthu Falls: A wide curtain of water just below the road near Thommankuthu town. Lunch in Thodupuzha after, own expense. (Short, steep path)
2:30 PM — Malankara Dam: The calm reservoir at Muttom: lakeside walkway, park and wide water views, with boating when it runs. (Paid direct if any)
5:00 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_MALANKARA.gtk:
💧 Water safety: No bathing, swimming or climbing on wet rocks anywhere on this tour — pools look calm but are deep. Children stay within arm's reach at the falls and by the reservoir.
🌧️ Rain & closures: The forest department can close Thommankuthu in heavy rain — we check the evening before. The falls are fullest from June to December; thin in April–May.
🥾 The walk: About 1–2 km of uneven forest path and rock at Thommankuthu, at your own pace. Shoes or sandals with grip; leeches are common in the monsoon.
🚌 Pickup points: Muvattupuzha first, then Thodupuzha — exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
IDK_MALANKARA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_MALANKARA.exc: Lunch; Forest, park and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_MALANKARA.carry: Sandals or shoes with grip; Spare clothes and a towel; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for tickets

IDK_MUNNAR.desc: Kerala's favourite hill station in one long day: roadside waterfalls on the climb, the Tea Museum, rolling estates and the lake at Mattupetty, with Echo Point on the elephant road.
IDK_MUNNAR.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Thodupuzha 6:00 · Muvattupuzha 6:30)
8:15 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest. Breakfast at Kothamangalam on the way, own expense. (Fullest in the monsoon)
10:00 AM — Tea Museum, Nullatanni: How tea goes from leaf to cup, with an old rolling machine and a tasting. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
11:15 AM — Tea estate viewpoints: Photo stops among the green estates on the Mattupetty road. (Estates are private land)
11:45 AM — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating, then the echo across the water. Lunch in Munnar town after. (Boating paid direct)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_MUNNAR.gtk:
⏱️ A long day: About 3½ hours each way on the NH 85 ghat via Adimali, with breaks. Eravikulam and Top Station need more time — ask us for a private 2-day trip.
🗓️ Closing days: The Tea Museum is closed on Mondays — that day we stop at a Pallivasal spice garden instead. Boating at Mattupetty depends on the weather and water level.
🐘 Wildlife: Elephants often cross the Mattupetty road — everyone stays inside if we stop. Never feed or approach animals; no flash photos.
🧥 Weather: Cool mornings and misty afternoons — bring a light layer. Heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints; we check the evening before.
IDK_MUNNAR.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_MUNNAR.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_MUNNAR.carry: Light jacket; Motion sickness tablets; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

IDK_VAGAMON.desc: Kerala's quiet hills, 90 minutes up from Thodupuzha: misty pine forest, rolling green meadows with the Kurisumala skyline, the lake, the adventure park and late views from Thangalpara.
IDK_VAGAMON.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Muvattupuzha 7:00 · Thodupuzha 7:30)
9:15 AM — Pine forest: Walk under tall pines on the slopes just outside Vagamon town. (Entry own expense)
10:30 AM — Vagamon meadows & lake: Rolling grass hills with the Kurisumala view, then the calm lake ringed by tea. Lunch in town after, own expense.
1:30 PM — Adventure park, Kolahalamedu: Paragliding in season and the glass bridge, when open. (Paid direct · operators confirm)
3:00 PM — Thangalpara: Hilltop rocks and a shrine with sweeping views over the valleys. (Easy uphill walk)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_VAGAMON.gtk:
🪂 Paragliding & glass bridge: Paragliding runs in season and only when the weather allows; pay the operator directly. The glass bridge has been closed for strengthening — we confirm if it's open before your trip.
🌧️ Weather: Mist rolls in most afternoons; grass slopes are slippery after rain. Best from September to May; heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints.
👟 Walking: Meadows, pine forest and Thangalpara involve short uphill walks. Elderly guests can enjoy most views close to the road.
🚌 Pickup points: Muvattupuzha first, then Thodupuzha — exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
IDK_VAGAMON.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_VAGAMON.exc: Lunch; Entry, paragliding and park tickets; Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

IDK_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? We pick you up at your door in Thodupuzha, Muvattupuzha or nearby and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and drive you home.
IDK_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Thodupuzha, Muvattupuzha, Vazhakulam or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~55–60 km on the MC Road: About 1.5 hours via Muvattupuzha, Perumbavoor and Kalady — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
IDK_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave at least 4.5 hours before an international flight and 3.5 hours before a domestic one. Muvattupuzha and Perumbavoor towns jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
IDK_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
IDK_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

IDK_MUNNAR2.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates to the horizon, the cliff-edge view from Top Station and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Munnar is about three hours from Thodupuzha.
IDK_MUNNAR2.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel or the Thodupuzha KSRTC stand; about 88 km via Neriamangalam and Adimali, roughly 3 hours.
Day 1 · 8:00 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. Breakfast at Adimali. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · late morning — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Early lunch in Munnar town. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Mattupetty, Echo Point & Kundala: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. (Boating paid direct)
Day 1 · 3:15 PM — Top Station: A cliff-edge view over the Western Ghats into Tamil Nadu. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~5 PM — Drive home: Leave after lunch; back at your door in Thodupuzha by early evening.
IDK_MUNNAR2.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we add Lakkam falls or a spice garden.
⛰️ Top Station: Mist often rolls in after 3 PM — clear views are never guaranteed. Steep steps lead down to the lower viewpoint; take it slowly.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
IDK_MUNNAR2.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
IDK_MUNNAR2.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
IDK_MUNNAR2.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

IDK_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — under four hours from Thodupuzha.
IDK_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel or the Thodupuzha KSRTC stand; about 116 km via Erattupetta and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 4 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~5:30 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door in Thodupuzha by evening.
IDK_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road from Mundakayam to Kuttikkanam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Cool nights in Thekkady; pleasant all year.
IDK_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
IDK_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
IDK_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

IDK_MARAYOOR.desc: Kerala's only natural sandalwood forest, Iron Age dolmens, Kanthalloor's fruit farms and the dry forest of Chinnar — the quiet rain-shadow side of Munnar.
IDK_MARAYOOR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door or the Thodupuzha KSRTC stand; about 128 km via Adimali and Munnar, roughly 5 hours.
Day 1 · late morning — Lakkam waterfalls: A forest-department waterfall on the Marayoor road, past Rajamala. (Entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Sandalwood forest & jaggery: Kerala's only natural sandalwood forest and jaggery in the making. Lunch in town.
Day 1 · 4:00 PM — Muniyara dolmens: Iron Age burial chambers near Kovilkadavu. Overnight in Marayoor or Kanthalloor. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 7:00 AM — Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary: A guided forest walk in dry thorn forest — look for the grizzled giant squirrel. (Paid direct · booked ahead)
Day 2 · late morning — Kanthalloor farms: Orchards and vegetable terraces; farm stalls sell whatever is in season. (Seasonal)
Day 2 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: Back past Munnar and down the ghat to your door in Thodupuzha.
IDK_MARAYOOR.gtk:
🌳 Sandalwood & jaggery: The sandalwood reserve is fenced and guarded — no stopping or walking inside. Buy GI-tagged Marayoor jaggery at the units or town shops — never 'sandalwood' from roadside sellers.
🐿️ Chinnar walks: Walks and treks are run by the Forest Department with local guides; numbers are limited, so we book ahead. Dry, hot forest: carry water, a cap and closed shoes.
🍎 Kanthalloor fruit: Apples, plums, oranges and passion fruit ripen in different months — what you see depends on the season. Farms are private: buy at the stalls and ask before entering.
🏨 Your stay: You book your stay in Marayoor or Kanthalloor; homestays and farm resorts are common. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
IDK_MARAYOOR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Marayoor & Kanthalloor drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
IDK_MARAYOOR.exc: Your stay; Meals; Trek, waterfall and entry fees; Tolls and parking
IDK_MARAYOOR.carry: Warm layer for the night; Walking shoes; Water bottle and cap; Cash for entry fees

IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.desc: Idukki's high range in a day: Kalvari Mount, the Anchuruli tunnel lake, spice-town Kattappana and windswept Ramakkalmedu.
IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel or Thodupuzha KSRTC stand. Breakfast at Cheruthoni.
8:45 AM — Kalvari Mount: A hilltop view over the blue Idukki reservoir and the Kuravan–Kurathi hills that hold the arch dam. (Entry own expense)
10:15 AM — Anchuruli: Where a long rock-cut tunnel from Irattayar spills into the Idukki lake, ringed by forest. (Tunnel closed · view only)
12:00 PM — Kattappana: Cardamom and pepper country's market town — lunch and spice shopping, own expense.
1:45 PM — Ramakkalmedu: The Kuravan–Kurathi statue, wind turbines and a cliff view over Tamil Nadu. (Entry own expense · very windy)
7:30 PM — Drop-off: Back via Kattappana, Cheruthoni and Kulamavu to your door.
IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.gtk:
🌬️ Ramakkalmedu: One of the windiest spots in Kerala — hold on to hats, phones and children at the cliff edge. DTPC ticket at the gate; open about 8:30 AM to 6 PM.
🚇 Anchuruli: Entry into the tunnel is prohibited — we view the tunnel mouth and lake from the bank. In the monsoon water pours out as a falls; stay well back.
⛰️ Hill roads: About 2 hours of winding road each way via Kulamavu and Cheruthoni. Carry motion-sickness tablets; we stop whenever you need.
🌧️ Weather: Best from September to March; mist and rain from June to August. Rain alerts can close viewpoints — we re-confirm the day before your trip.
IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All high-range sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.exc: Meals; Entry tickets; Tolls and parking
IDK_RAMAKKALMEDU.carry: Windcheater or light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Motion-sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

IDK_KOCHI.desc: Your own vehicle from Thodupuzha to old Kochi: Chinese fishing nets, India's oldest European church, the Dutch Palace murals, Jew Town and a Marine Drive walk.
IDK_KOCHI.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel or Thodupuzha KSRTC stand. Breakfast on the way at Muvattupuzha.
9:15 AM — Fort Kochi: fishing nets & churches: Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church (Vasco da Gama's first grave) and Santa Cruz Basilica. (Modest dress in the churches)
11:15 AM — Mattancherry Palace: The 'Dutch Palace' with its Ramayana murals and royal portraits. (Closed Fridays · entry own expense)
12:00 PM — Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue: Antique shops, spice stores and the 1568 synagogue. Lunch here, own expense. (Synagogue closed Fri & Sat)
2:30 PM — Kerala Folklore Museum: Masks, costumes and carved wooden halls from across South India. (Entry own expense)
4:00 PM — Marine Drive: A walk on the backwater promenade, or shopping on MG Road.
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Home via Tripunithura and Muvattupuzha, back to your door.
IDK_KOCHI.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Mattancherry Palace is closed on Fridays; the synagogue on Fridays, Saturdays and Jewish holidays. On those days we swap in the Hill Palace Museum at Tripunithura — it's on the way home.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered for the churches, synagogue and palace. No photos inside the synagogue or the palace galleries.
🚶 Walking: Fort Kochi and Jew Town are best on foot — about 3–4 km of easy walking in all. Wear comfortable shoes; lanes are uneven in places.
🧭 Your day, your way: It's a private trip — add Lulu Mall, a harbour ferry or an early dinner in the city. About 2 hours each way via Muvattupuzha; evening traffic can add 30 minutes.
IDK_KOCHI.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Kochi sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
IDK_KOCHI.exc: Meals; Palace, synagogue and museum entry; Tolls and parking
IDK_KOCHI.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

IDK_ALAPPUZHA.desc: Drive from Thodupuzha through Kottayam and Kuttanad's paddy country, board a houseboat by noon and drift through Alappuzha's canals, with a night on the water and a beach stop before home.
IDK_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
Day 1 · 8:30 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel or Thodupuzha KSRTC stand.
Day 1 · 8:45 AM — Drive to Alappuzha: About 105 km via Koothattukulam, Kottayam and the AC Road through the paddy fields — roughly 3 hours with a tea break.
Day 1 · 12 noon — Board your houseboat: Cruise the backwaters with lunch, dinner and breakfast cooked on board. Overnight on the boat. (Houseboat booked by you · paid direct)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Check-out at the jetty: Your driver meets you at the boarding point with the vehicle.
Day 2 · 9:30 AM — Alappuzha beach: Optional — a walk by the old pier and the lighthouse before the drive home. (No swimming in rough sea)
Day 2 · ~1:30 PM — Home: Back via Kottayam to your door in Thodupuzha.
IDK_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🚤 Booking the houseboat: You book and pay the houseboat directly; we can share contacts of licensed operators we trust. Check-in is usually around noon, check-out about 9 AM.
🛏️ On board: Boats stop cruising by early evening and anchor for the night. Ask the operator about AC hours, menus and life jackets.
🚗 Your driver: The vehicle stays with the driver in Alappuzha overnight. His night allowance is in our price.
🌧️ Season: Best from September to March; peak Dec–Jan — book early. In heavy rain the AC Road can flood; we reroute and cruise routes may be shortened.
IDK_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Thodupuzha ⇄ Alappuzha jetty drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
IDK_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Houseboat (paid direct); Meals off the boat; Tolls and parking
IDK_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Swimwear and a change of clothes; Mosquito repellent; Sunscreen and hat; ID for the houseboat check-in

IDK_KODAIKANAL.desc: A star-shaped lake, cliff-edge walks and pillar rocks in the Palani hills — over Idukki's high range, down the Kumily ghat to Theni and up to Tamil Nadu's cool retreat, with your own vehicle and driver.
IDK_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Kodaikanal: From your door in Thodupuzha — about 270 km via Kattappana, Kumily, Theni and the Kodai ghat, roughly 10 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Kodai Lake: A walk, a cycle or a boat round the star-shaped lake. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Coaker's Walk & Bryant Park: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains, then the gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Thodupuzha by evening.
IDK_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🎫 Kodaikanal e-pass: Tourist vehicles need a Tamil Nadu e-pass for Kodaikanal — we apply for it. Plastic is restricted: carry refillable bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: We cross into Tamil Nadu at Kumily; permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🧥 A long, winding drive: About 10 hours each way over the Idukki hills and two ghats — carry motion-sickness tablets. Cool all year, cold at night — bring warm layers.
IDK_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
IDK_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
IDK_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Motion-sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

IDK_VELANKANNI.desc: Over the Kumily hills to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, candle prayers and a full, unhurried day at the shrine by the sea.
IDK_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:15 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (≈520 km via Kumily & Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Evening prayer: Reach Velankanni by about 6 PM; candles and prayer at the Shrine Basilica. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Malayalam Mass at the Morning Star Church, then Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross. (Times re-confirmed)
Day 2 · late morning — Museum & Old Church: The museum of offerings and the Old Church by Our Lady's Tank. Lunch near the shrine (own expense).
Day 2 · evening — Beach & candle prayers: A walk on Velankanni beach, then the evening rosary and candles at the basilica. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · ≈6:30 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way (Leaves Velankanni 5 AM)
IDK_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Shoulders and knees covered; follow the volunteers in the queues and keep silence in the chapels. Masses run daily in Tamil, English and other languages — we re-confirm the Malayalam Mass time before you travel.
🌊 Beach & crowds: No sea bathing — the sea is rough and drownings are reported. We fix one meeting point at the main arch; children stay with an adult.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room near the shrine — we share a list of pilgrim lodges. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long road & border: About 520 km each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; ghats in daylight. Tamil Nadu permit and border tax at actual cost; carry a photo ID.
IDK_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
IDK_VELANKANNI.carry: Photo ID; Modest clothes for church; Light cotton and a sun cap; Cash for offerings and candles

IDK_PEERMADE.desc: Old Travancore hill country: Panchalimedu's Pandava legend and misty ridges, the queen's summer palace at Kuttikkanam, a granite church among tea gardens and the great Parunthumpara rock.
IDK_PEERMADE.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Muvattupuzha 6:00 · Thodupuzha 6:30)
9:00 AM — Panchalimedu: Hilltop Devi temple, Panchali's pond and misty views. Breakfast on the way. (Ticket own expense)
10:45 AM — Ammachi Kottaram, Kuttikkanam: The Travancore queen's summer palace, now private — seen from outside. (Outside view only)
11:45 AM — Pattumala church: A domed granite church amid tea estates. Lunch in Peermade after. (Modest dress)
2:15 PM — Parunthumpara: 'Eagle Rock' — a vast rock sheet above deep valleys. (Stay back from the edge)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_PEERMADE.gtk:
⛰️ The hilltops: Panchalimedu and Parunthumpara are open, windy rock and grass — no shade, no railings at the edges. Mist rolls in fast; we keep groups together and leave a viewpoint when it closes in.
🏰 The palace: Ammachi Kottaram is private property today — we stop at the roadside for the view and the story, not inside. Pattumala church welcomes visitors; keep silence during Mass and dress modestly.
🚌 The drive: About 2½ hours each way via Erattupetta, Mundakayam and the Kuttikkanam ghat — many bends. Tell us if you get travel-sick; we stop for tea on the climb and on the way home.
🚉 Pickup points: Muvattupuzha first, then Thodupuzha — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
IDK_PEERMADE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_PEERMADE.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Viewpoint tickets (paid direct); Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_PEERMADE.carry: Light jacket or shawl; Walking shoes with grip; Cap and sunscreen; Travel-sickness tablets if needed

IDK_PONMUDI.desc: Idukki's quiet river country beyond Kallarkutty: the five stepped cascades of Sreenarayanapuram, a forest lake at Ponmudi with its swaying footbridge, and tea by the Kallarkutty dam.
IDK_PONMUDI.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station · Muvattupuzha · your hotel on the way (Muvattupuzha 6:30 · Thodupuzha 7:00)
9:15 AM — Sreenarayanapuram falls: The 'ripple falls': five stepped cascades on the Muthirapuzha, with walkways and viewing decks. (Ticket own expense · no bathing)
11:00 AM — Ponmudi dam & hanging bridge: The dam road over a forest-ringed lake, then the footbridge on the Panniyar. Lunch in Rajakkad, own expense. (Hold the rails)
2:30 PM — Kallarkutty dam: The reservoir below the hills at Kallarkutty — tea and photos before the drive home. (Photo stop)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Thodupuzha KSRTC bus station, Muvattupuzha, or your own stop on the way
IDK_PONMUDI.gtk:
💧 At the falls: A park run by the district tourism council, with walkways, decks and a pool viewing area. Tickets are sold at the gate. No bathing or climbing on the rocks — the river rises fast after rain, and the falls are fullest then.
🌉 Ponmudi: The hanging bridge sways — one group at a time, hold the rails, no running or rocking it. The dam and reservoir are KSEB property; photos from the road and the walkways only.
🚌 The drive: About 2 hours each way on hill roads via Vannappuram, Venmani and Kallarkutty — many bends. Tell us if you get travel-sick; we stop for tea on the way.
🚉 Pickup points: Muvattupuzha first, then Thodupuzha — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the reverse order, or at your own stop on the way.
IDK_PONMUDI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
IDK_PONMUDI.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Falls ticket (paid direct); Tolls and parking (private trips)
IDK_PONMUDI.carry: Walking shoes with grip; Light raincoat or umbrella; Cap and sunscreen; Travel-sickness tablets if needed

IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.desc: Kumily's month-long summer flower show — thousands of blooms, garden displays and plant stalls a short walk from Thekkady junction — with time for the spice town's markets. Your own vehicle and driver for the day. Event dates: ≈Apr–early May 2027 · about a month (Estimate — confirm with the show organisers).
IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thodupuzha KSRTC stand, Kattappana or Cochin Airport.
8:00 AM — Breakfast on the way: Erattupetta or Mundakayam, then the Kuttikkanam ghat and the tea country of Peermade. (Own expense)
11:00 AM — Thekkady Flower Show: Blooms, garden displays and plant stalls at the show ground near Thekkady junction. (Ticket paid direct)
2:30 PM — Lunch & Kumily spice market: Lunch in Kumily, then cardamom, pepper and tea from fixed-price shops. (Own expense)
9:00 PM — Home: Leave Kumily by 5 PM; back home, to your hotel or the station.
IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.gtk:
🌸 The show: Held every summer at a ground about 200 m from Thekkady junction, open 10 AM–10 PM in 2026. Flowering plants and seeds are on sale — carry a bag or box for anything you buy.
📅 Dates: The 2026 show ran from early April to 3 May; we expect a similar window in 2027. The organisers announce the dates in March — we confirm before your trip.
🚗 The drive: About 116 km each way via Erattupetta and the Kuttikkanam ghat — many bends. We leave Kumily by about 5 PM so most of the ghat is in daylight.
👨‍👩‍👧 Families: Children under 10 entered free in 2026; tickets for others at the gate. Evenings are cool in Kumily — carry a light layer.
IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thodupuzha or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Show tickets and shopping
IDK_EV_FLOWERSHOW.carry: Cap and sunscreen; Bag or box for plants; Light layer for the evening; Phone, charged, with our number saved

IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.desc: Watch the Makarajyothi glow on Ponnambalamedu from Panchalimedu, one of Idukki's official viewing hills — no Sabarimala queues. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits through the dusk, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Thu 14 Jan 2027 · dusk at Panchalimedu (Estimate — confirm with TDB & Idukki district administration).
IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.itin:
10:00 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thodupuzha KSRTC stand, Kattappana or Cochin Airport.
12:30 PM — Lunch on the way: Via Erattupetta and Mundakayam (≈75 km). Lunch before the hill. (Own expense)
2:00 PM — Drop near Panchalimedu: As close as the police allow near Murinjapuzha; walk up. (Walk the last stretch)
≈6:40 PM — Makarajyothi: After the Sabarimala deeparadhana, the light glows on Ponnambalamedu. (Main moment)
Midnight — Home: Pickup once the crowd thins; back home, hotel or station.
IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.gtk:
✨ Makaravilakku: On Makara Sankranti the Makarajyothi is seen on Ponnambalamedu facing Sabarimala, just after the evening deeparadhana. Idukki's district administration runs viewing points at Panchalimedu, Parunthumpara and Pullumedu, with police and medical teams.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Kerala Tourism lists Makaravilakku on Thursday 14 January 2027; some calendars put it on 15 January. The Devaswom Board fixes the day — we re-confirm before your trip.
🧥 On the hill: Open, windy grass on a cold January evening — carry a shawl, torch and water. No railings at the edges; keep children close, and leave only when the police open the way down.
IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thodupuzha or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Viewpoint tickets and offerings
IDK_EV_MAKARAJYOTHI.carry: Shawl or light jacket; Torch and water bottle; Mat or towel to sit on; Phone, charged, with our number saved

IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.desc: Once a year, on Chithra Pournami, the ancient Kannagi temple on Mangaladevi peak inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve opens for a single day. We take you to Kumily the day before; forest jeeps take you up at dawn. Event dates: ≈Tue 20 Apr 2027 · open one day a year (Estimate — confirm with Idukki & Theni district administrations).
IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.itin:
Day 1 · 2:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thodupuzha KSRTC stand, Kattappana or Cochin Airport.
Day 1 · evening — Kumily: ≈116 km via the Kuttikkanam ghat. Overnight in Kumily, your booking. (Book your stay early)
Day 2 · 5:30 AM — Forest jeep to the peak: Jeeps leave the Kumily bus stand from 5:30 AM; no private cars. (Jeep fare paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Darshan at Mangaladevi: Kannagi's old stone temple on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border. (Leave the forest by 5 PM)
Day 2 · ~6:00 PM — Home: Down by jeep, lunch in Kumily, then home.
IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.gtk:
🛕 The temple: A ruined stone temple to Kannagi, heroine of the Tamil epic Silappathikaram, about 1,337 m up on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border. It lies inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve and opens to devotees only on Chithra Pournami.
🌳 Forest rules: In 2026 the forest gate opened at 6 AM and closed to entry at 2:30 PM; everyone had to be out by 5 PM — no night stay. No plastic bottles or covers, no non-veg food, no cooking, no photos or drones inside the forest.
📅 Date: Chithra Pournami falls on Tuesday 20 April 2027 by the calendar. The Idukki and Theni collectors fix the festival day and rules — we re-confirm before your trip.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thodupuzha or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Forest jeep fare and offerings
IDK_EV_MANGALADEVI.carry: Steel water bottle (no plastic); Veg food wrapped in banana leaf; Cap, comfortable footwear; ID card and a little cash
